plan.notes: AA Women and Gender Studies, South Mountain Community College. Sequence taken verbatim from the award page's published Full-time course sequence (default/base pathway option; alternate pathway-option rows excluded). Category placeholders (e.g. Accounting Coursework, Mathematics, Elective, RE) are genuine choose-from-category slots transcribed as choice slots with the published label. Credit ranges sequenced at their minimum. Rows with no credit value are section labels, excluded. Prerequisites are not shown as clean course codes in the sequence and are not transcribed (all prereq arrays empty). No catalog year is printed on the page; 2026-2027 is the retrieval-year stamp.
